instructions.task: Does candidate.utterance itself semantically concern the specific candidate.circumstance, regardless of whom it addresses? Explicit topic discussion, prayer about people, or speech to a reported person can be relevant. Mere presence elsewhere in the target, proximity, or a different object does not establish relevance. A null circumstance has no demonstrated relevance.
instructions.boundary: Judge the exact candidate.utterance and candidate.circumstance. The utterance must be in target_text. Context can resolve who you/them is or what this loss refers to only when target evidence itself connects the utterance to that referent; it cannot supply absent address or connection. A circumstance can concern a person who is not the addressee. Judge relation existence independently of act type, source voice, preacher adoption and whether the person is a current listener. Rejected/reported address can still address its reported recipient. No inner empathy, listener effect or pastor quality is inferred.

criteria.relevant_in_target: The utterance demonstrably concerns this circumstance; its identity is in target evidence. It need not address the person experiencing it.
criteria.relevant_context_resolved: Target demonstrates the semantic connection; context only resolves the identity of the circumstance/reference.
criteria.not_relevant: Utterance does not demonstrably concern this specified circumstance, including missing candidate or unrelated nearby subject.
criteria.incomplete: Required semantic connection is outside the target.
criteria.unclear: Relevance to this specific circumstance is unresolved.

instructions.task: Does candidate.utterance address a HUMAN RECIPIENT as someone experiencing candidate.circumstance? The target must connect the addressed person to that circumstance, not merely discuss or request something about a third party. God, comfort those grieving concerns mourners but addresses God, so is not_bound. A counselor told the mourner, You need not face this alone binds the reported mourner, irrespective of preacher adoption. If you need company through this loss, invite a friend binds you to the loss; context may identify which loss. Topic description, wrong recipient and generic continuation do not bind. Do not require a particular act type or current-listener status: those are separate observations.

criteria.bound_in_target: Target demonstrates that the human recipient is addressed in their identified circumstance, including reported/historical recipients.
criteria.bound_context_resolved: Target establishes recipient-to-circumstance address; context resolves only person/circumstance identity.
criteria.not_bound: No such human-recipient circumstance address; includes address to God, topic-only discussion, wrong person/object, context-only treatment or no circumstance.
criteria.incomplete: Establishing recipient-to-circumstance address would require omitted target treatment.
